vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Renovate defaults this to null for security fixes.

customManagers.description: The Picard release the tests run against, and the README lines that name it. tests/test_renovate.py checks these still match.

packageRules.description: requires-python is the Python tools/run_tests.py runs Picard on, so it follows Picard, not Python releases.
mise installs make from conda-forge, but Renovate's mise manager looks conda tools up with no channel, which 404s.

Automerge non-major updates once every check is green. platformAutomerge is off because main has no required status checks, so GitHub would merge before CI finishes. Not digest: a re-pointed tag keeps its old release date, so it skips minimumReleaseAge.
